arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox', event_id, json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status <> 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', b.booking_id, json_object('request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'has_hold',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'has_checkin',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id) UNION ALL SELECT 'charge', charge_id, json_object('booking_id',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount_cents',amount_cents,'state',state,'created_step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE state <> 'captured' UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request_id',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache
